title: The Preamble, Word by Word

endcard.line: Pictures: unknown photographer (public domain); unknown photographer (public domain)

segments.say: Our Constitution opens with five words that describe the country: sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic, republic.
The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on the twenty-sixth of November, nineteen forty-nine. Its Preamble begins: We, the People of India.

items.text: Sovereign Democratic Republic; unity of the Nation
42nd Amendment adds Socialist, Secular, and integrity

segments.say: In nineteen seventy-six, the Forty-second Amendment added two of those words, socialist and secular, and changed 'unity of the Nation' to 'unity and integrity of the Nation'.

anim.title: Four promises
items: Liberty: of thought, expression, belief, faith, worship
Equality: of status and of opportunity

segments.say: Then come four promises: justice, social, economic and political; liberty of thought, expression, belief, faith and worship; equality of status and of opportunity; and fraternity.
Fraternity is tied to two things: the dignity of each person, and the unity and integrity of the nation.
Notice who acts in the last line. The people, through their Assembly, adopt, enact and give the Constitution to themselves.
For GS Two, learn the Preamble word by word, and remember which words came in nineteen seventy-six.

sources: Constitution of India, official English text (Legislative Department diglot PDF, legislative.gov.in, 'as on' 2024 edition): the Preamble (full text; 'SOVEREIGN SOCIALIST SECULAR DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC' and 'unity and integrity of the Nation' substituted by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s.2, w.e.f. 3-1-1977; 'IN OUR CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY this twenty-sixth day of November, 1949, do HEREBY ADOPT, ENACT AND GIVE TO OURSELVES THIS CONSTITUTION')

quiz.q: Which two words did the 42nd Amendment add to describe India in the Preamble?
On what date did the Constituent Assembly adopt the Constitution?
quiz.why: The Preamble: 'this twenty-sixth day of November, 1949'.

quiz.q: Fraternity in the Preamble assures the dignity of the individual and…
options: the unity and integrity of the Nation
quiz.why: 'Assuring the dignity of the individual and the unity and integrity of the Nation'.

reviewNote: All facts are from the official Constitution text, including the 42nd Amendment footnotes. The brief suggested the Constitution's cover page; the illuminated manuscript pages (Nandalal Bose and his students) may still be in copyright, so the video uses Constituent Assembly photos instead. Both photos show historical figures only. Moving facts: none.
